title: OnChainDiligence Public Action Receipt v1
description: A human-facing, independently verifiable projection of an Agent Evidence run: what action was proposed, what evidence existed, what decision was reached, whether execution and settlement occurred, and what remains unknown. A public receipt is an OPT-IN, redacted view -- it must never contain private mandate text, customer names, raw KYC/KYB evidence, credentials, tokens, or secrets. Decision, Execution, and Settlement are independent statements; none of them implies the others, and none is the same claim as receipt PROOF (whether the signer asserted this exact content).

receiptId.description: A deterministic, human-friendly LOCATOR derived from receipt_digest (Crockford Base32 of the first 10 digest bytes). It is not itself authoritative -- a resolver must confirm receipt_digest matches before trusting a lookup by this id.

receiptAction.title: The proposed or executed action, in public-safe terms.

network.description: CAIP-2 network id where applicable, or null when the action is not chain-scoped or the network was not recorded.

sender.description: A wallet address, when known. Never a legal/company identity -- an identity binding requires its own evidence and is never inferred here.

recipient.description: A wallet address, when known. Same identity-binding caveat as sender.

receiptDecision.title: The policy/mandate decision. Independent of execution, settlement, and receipt proof.

authorized.description: Whether the mandate/policy authorized execution. null only when genuinely unknown -- never a substitute for BLOCK or ALLOW.

receiptExecution.title: Whether the action was actually submitted for execution. A transaction hash present does NOT mean settlement is confirmed -- see receiptSettlement.

provider.description: The execution provider/rail, e.g. "x402" or "paybox", when applicable.

receiptSettlement.title: Whether value movement was independently confirmed. Distinct from execution: a submitted transaction is not necessarily settled.

id.description: A stable, kebab-case check identifier, e.g. "wallet-sanctions-screen".

evidence_digest.description: Digest reference into the (private, or separately published) Agent Evidence graph. Never the evidence content itself.

preflight_receipt_id.description: For a COMMERCE receipt, the PREFLIGHT receipt it followed, when one exists.

receipt_digest.description: sha256 over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of every receipt field EXCEPT receipt_id and receipt_digest themselves -- see docs/PUBLIC_ACTION_RECEIPT_V1.md for the exact algorithm.

proof.title: onchaindiligence.attestation.v2 signature over the exact receipt object above -- the same signing scheme and key/lifecycle registry already used across the product. Signature means the signer asserted this exact receipt content, nothing about the underlying facts' objective truth.
